# Commands console reliability, task recovery, storage retention, and patch identity

Retention policy: shared Try download cache is capped at 5 GiB/7 days; build snapshots 10 GiB/14 days; inactive assessment and task evidence are removed while verdict state remains. Active tasks acquire storage leases. Imported Try history lacks saved source selection and is intentionally inactive; expose it as `imported-history`. [Task 2]

Scope: console.
